column1: # Per-bundle OIDC trust expectation (spec 009, FR-014). HARNESS TEST DATA: this
# table is read only by bin/lib/trusted-tls.sh; nothing in the product consumes it.
#   service   compose service that makes the OIDC back-channel call
#   runtime   go | node | python | unknown   (what the app's image runs)
#   probe     node | python | curl | none     (what the probe execs in the container)
# covered      -> a failed probe FAILS the app at stage sso-trust
# unverified / not-covered -> SKIP "trust not covered" (never hides install failures)
# An app absent from this table is not a native-oidc app: the step is not run.
